heading: INT. NEXUS ARENA - FINALS STAGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NEXUS ARENA - FINALS STAGE - NIGHT
A packed esports arena.
Strobing blue light.
Two gaming rigs on a raised platform, a huge screen above.
WREN, 20s, hoodie, headset around her neck, sits dead still.
Her coach HALE, 50s, crouches beside her chair.
Match four, final round. Players, please confirm your connection.
units.name: ADMIN

units.text: In the crowd, a TEENAGE BOY lowers his phone.
An old SECURITY GUARD scans the aisles, bored.
ANGLE ON THE SCREEN
Wren's character, a knight, stands in an empty grey corridor.
There is no opponent's name in the lobby.
ON SCREEN: PLAYER 2 HAS JOINED (0 ms)
Wren. Look at me.
units.name: HALE

units.text: I'm looking at it.
units.name: WREN

units.text: No. At me.
units.name: HALE

units.text: She does. (beat)

Twelve years I've done this. I have seen every kind of cheat there is. Lag switches, ghost accounts, a kid who taped a second keyboard under his desk. And I've been telling you since the qualifiers that something is wrong, and you keep saying "it's just a bug." You're a better player than a bug.
units.name: HALE

units.text: It is a bug.
units.name: WREN

units.text: Then why did it say your mother's name in the chat?
units.name: HALE

units.text: CLOSE ON the chat window.
A single line.
ON SCREEN: > hello wren. you left the door open.
Wren pulls her hands off the keyboard.
Hale grabs the cable.
The screen doesn't flicker.
The game keeps playing without them.
WREN! WREN! WREN!
units.name: THE CROWD

units.text: The teenage boy drops his drink.
The guard turns, hand to his radio.
WE SEE every monitor in the arena flip to the same grey corridor.
The knight turns, slowly, to the camera.
Please remain seated. We are experiencing a technical difficulty.
units.name: ADMIN

units.text: Get up. Wren. Get up.
units.name: HALE

units.text: If I stand up it gets in here.
units.name: WREN

units.text: BACK TO SCENE
Hale stares at her.
The strobes slow.
Stop.
Wren.
units.name: THE CROWD

units.text: The doors of the arena clank shut.
Every single one.
Wren pulls the headset onto her ears.
Tell my mother I'm sorry about the name.
units.name: WREN

units.text: She picks up the controller.
The knight raises its sword.
Don't.
units.name: HALE

units.text: Everyone in the front row stands and sits down in unison.
FADE OUT.
